recommendation: Keep this commit for the current active Contract resource. If FHIR-55563 later lands and removes or relocates Contract, that broader work should supersede this cleanup; until then, the built spec should not describe Contract.term.action as an entity or link readers to removed Contract.action paths.
issue_request: FHIR-5907 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and asked that vague Contract.action/actionReason definitions be made clear; the final resolution required Contract.term actions to be clearly defined based on the term topic and offer.topic contents.
initial_application: No direct FHIR-5907/GF#5907 implementation commit was found. Later Contract rework under FHIR-13403/GF#13403 created the current term.action structure, but the active source still described Contract.term.action as an entity/actor responsibility and retained removed Contract.action path references.
additional_context: Contract is active in source/fhir.ini. The old consentdirective profile still has Contract.term.actionReason, but fhir.ini marks ConsentDirective as retired and does not list it as an active profile. A 2025 Zulip thread independently flagged the action-as-entity wording as confusing. FHIR-55563 proposes removing Contract but is only Resolved - change required and its removal branch is not current HEAD.
reconciliation: Changed source/contract/structuredefinition-Contract.xml so Contract.term.action is an action required or prohibited by the term and tied to Contract.term.topic[x] or Contract.term.offer.topic; replaced stale Contract.action, Contract.topic.term, and Contract.valuedItem references with current paths in the StructureDefinition and Event/Request mapping exception source; synchronized the checked-in Contract SVG tooltip for the edited action node.
source_changes: source/contract/structuredefinition-Contract.xml: clarified Contract.term.action short/definition/comment/requirements and corrected stale Contract.subject/topic path references.
source/contract/contract-request-mapping-exceptions.xml: updated Contract.subject requirements text to current Contract.term paths.
source/contract/contract-event-mapping-exceptions.xml: updated Contract.subject requirements text to current Contract.term paths.
source/contract/contract.svg: synchronized the Contract.term.action diagram tooltip with the authoritative StructureDefinition definition.
